title: 2030 — First city-scale federation hulls pilots launch: server coops is
definition: 2030 milestone on the Cooperative Cloud Federations roadmap.
description:
First city-scale federation hulls pilots launch: server coops issuance and federation logistics exchange running live.

What must be true first: the server coops results have to replicate outside the lab, federation logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and workload sharing operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed server coops demonstrations, federation logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting workload sharing uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Cooperative Cloud Federations Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Cooperative Cloud Federations operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Cooperative Cloud Federations installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 54131 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where server coops monitoring, federation logistics redundancy, or workload sharing maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Cooperative Cloud Federations Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Cooperative Cloud Federations: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Cooperative Cloud Federations — federations running shared cloud infrastructure.

Phase 1 — Prove (server coops): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (federation logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (workload sharing): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (member governance): federation hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and tech-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
